properties.description: Enforces the NRIT baseline tagging strategy, using the Cloud Adoption Framework tag keys: resource groups must carry the mandatory tags (app, opsteam, criticality, confidentiality) with allowed values, and resources inherit the baseline tags from their subscription and resource group when missing. Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/azure-best-practices/resource-tagging

nonComplianceMessages.message: Baseline tag governance {enforcementMode} be applied: resource groups need the mandatory tags (app, opsteam, criticality, confidentiality) with allowed values.
